run_validate_trace: run the validate_trace CLI to validate a trace file at minimal, standard, or complete level
validate_trace_format: validate a trace file format against expected argument specs and return errors
get_argument_spec: get the list of AttributeSpec for a given validation level like minimal or complete
get_expected_arguments: extract expected arguments as a pandas DataFrame from a list of AttributeSpec objects
check_args: check trace event arguments against expected types and collect skipped or type-violating keys
